en.headline: eMPF opens one-stop account enquiry from Monday
en.dek: Members, authorised persons and estate handlers will be able to request trustee names, account numbers and balances in one application.
body: The eMPF platform will launch a one-stop MPF account enquiry service on Monday, Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority chairwoman Ayesha Macpherson Lau said in a blog published on Sunday.

Scheme members, authorised persons, estate administrators of deceased members, and people with priority to manage a member's estate may apply to see the trustee and scheme name, account number and balance. Lau said the authority's older personal-account e-enquiry only returned the number of accounts and trustee contact details, so people still had to approach each trustee separately for balances.

She said eMPF, fully in operation since April, already lets a registered member view their own accounts after login. The new service is aimed at people who cannot handle accounts themselves, and at relatives dealing with a deceased member's assets.

Hong Kong 01, citing the same blog, reported that an authorised applicant must submit a form signed by the member and identity documents. eMPF will email or text the member to confirm the request and check the signature against its records before releasing details. Estate applications need probate or letters of administration; people claiming priority must show proof of relationship.

zh.headline: 積金易明起推一站式帳戶查詢
zh.dek: 計劃成員、獲授權人士及處理遺產人士可一次申請查閱受託人、帳戶號碼及結餘。
body: 積金局主席劉麥嘉軒周日在網誌表示，「積金易」平台將於周一（5日）推出一站式「強積金帳戶資料查詢服務」。
強積金計劃成員、獲授權人士、已故成員的遺產代理人，以及有優先權利管理成員遺產的人士，可申請查閱受託人及計劃名稱、帳戶號碼和結餘。她說，局方以往的個人帳戶電子查詢只提供帳戶數目及受託人聯絡資料，查結餘仍要逐一聯絡受託人。
劉麥嘉軒指，「積金易」今年四月全面運作後，已登記成員登入即可查看自己的帳戶。新服務針對未能親自處理強積金的成員，以及要處理已故成員資產的親屬。
《香港01》引述同一篇網誌報道，獲授權人士申請時須交由成員簽署的授權表格及身份證明文件。「積金易」會以電郵或短訊通知成員確認申請，並核對簽署，完成核實後才提供資料。遺產代理人須交遺囑認證書或遺產管理書；聲稱有優先權利的人士則須證明與已故成員的關係。
